meta.title: mise · Meal Planner App | Weekly Meal Plans, Recipes & Meal Prep
meta.description: mise is a meal planner app for weekly meal planning, recipes, meal prep and food prep. Build a personalised meal plan, get recipe ideas, and one smart shopping list for your supermarket.

hero.sub: mise is a meal planner for weekly meal planning and meal prep. Plan dinners around your budget, your cravings, and what's already in your kitchen. Build your week and one smart shopping list in about five minutes.

marquee.heading: Built around the supermarkets you already shop at

how.title: Dinner sorted in seconds
how.sub: No spreadsheets, no scrolling recipe blogs. Just tell mise a little about you and it does the planning.
how.step1Body: {{step1Shops}}. Prices and lists are tuned to where you actually shop.
how.step2Body: Budget, dietary needs, allergies, kitchen kit and the meal vibes you're into.

reviewsSection.title: Real weeknights, sorted
reviewsSection.sub: A few words from people who let mise plan their week.
reviewsSection.r1Body: didnt think i needed another app but grocery spend is definitely down. idk maybe $25–30? wife sends me the list now so im not just wandering aldi adding stuff
reviewsSection.r2Body: Everything's doable after work which is basically my only requirement lol. no random ingredients my kids refuse to touch
reviewsSection.r3Title: the list is the best part
reviewsSection.r3Body: pick walmart, get the plan, text the list to my husband. we kept buying the same stuff twice every week before this
reviewsSection.r4Body: same general idea but without tiny portions and the crazy bill. does what i need it to do
reviewsSection.r5Body: steps are clear enough that he stopped defaulting to doordash like twice a week. didnt see that coming
reviewsSection.r6Body: most stuff is ~30 mins. thats literally why i kept paying for it nothing fancy

faqSection.title: Good to know
faqSection.a1: mise is built around major supermarkets including {{faqStores}} and more, with support for stores across several countries. Your plan and shopping list are tuned to the shop you choose.
faqSection.q2: Can it handle dietary needs and allergies?
faqSection.a2: Yes. Set preferences like vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian or gluten-free and flag allergens to avoid. Please always check ingredient labels before cooking. mise can't guarantee allergen safety.
faqSection.a3: mise is a subscription. You can explore the app and see how it works, with full planning unlocked by a subscription managed through the App Store or Google Play. Cancel anytime from your store account.
faqSection.q4: Do I have to cook every meal on my plan?
faqSection.a4: Not at all. Plan as many or as few nights as you like, up to seven. Swap any meal you don't fancy, regenerate the whole week, or just cook the ones you like. Your shopping list updates to match.
faqSection.q5: Will it really save me money?
faqSection.a5: Most people save by planning ahead, buying only what they need and reusing ingredients across meals. Savings vary by household and shop.
faqSection.a6: We only use your preferences to build your plans and never sell your personal information. See our Privacy Policy for details.
